bitRanges.name: Set Communication Path
bitRanges.description:
00h Page 0 (Rail 1), 
01h Page 1 (Rail 1), 
02h Page 2 (Rail 2), 
80h Individual phase (set by the PHASE command), 
FFh Global (All Rails)

bitRanges.name: Enable/Disable Output
bitRanges.description: 0 = Disable, 1 = Enable

bitRanges.name: Disable Behavior
bitRanges.description: 0 = Immediate off (decay with PWM tri-state), 1 = Soft off (Use TOFF_DELAY and TOFF_FALL)

bitRanges.name: Vout Source
bitRanges.description: 00 = VOUT_COMMAND, 01 = VOUT_MARGIN_LOW, 10 = VOUT_MARGIN_HIGH, 11 = Not used

bitRanges.name: Margin Response
bitRanges.description: 01 = Ignore Vout OV, UV faults when margined, 10 = Act on Vout OV, UV faults when margined

bitRanges.name: Sets the source of enable
bitRanges.description: 0XX = Output enables any time power is present regardless of pin or OPERATION command state, 101 = Output enables from the enable pin only, 110 = Output enables from the OPERATION command only, 111 = Output enables from the enable pin AND the OPERATION command

bitRanges.name: Polarity of ENABLE pin
bitRanges.description: 0 = Active low, 1 = Active high

bitRanges.name: ENABLE pin action when commanding the unit to turn off
bitRanges.description: 0 = Use the configured TOFF_DELAY and TOFF_FALL settings, 1 = Turn off the output immediately (decay with PWM tri-state)

bitRanges.name: Protection Level
bitRanges.description: 1000 0000 = Disable all writes except to WRITE_PROTECT command. 0100 0000 = Disable all writes except to WRITE_PROTECT, OPERATION, and PAGE. 0010 0000 = Disable all writes except to WRITE_PROTECT, OPERATION, PAGE, ON_OFF_CONFIG, and VOUT_COMMAND. 0000 0010 = Disable all writes except to WRITE_PROTECT, OPERATION, PAGE, ON_OFF_CONFIG, VOUT_COMMAND, and DMA. 0000 0000 = Enable all writes

bitRanges.name: Maximum Bus Speed

bitRanges.name: SMBALERT Support

bitRanges.name: Numeric Format
